1. Information We Collect

When you visit DigitalTalha or contact us, we may collect the following information:

  • Provided via Forms: Name, Email, WhatsApp/Phone number, Business Name, and project details.
  • Direct Communication: Messages sent via our WhatsApp integration or direct email.
  • Tracking Data: Basic website usage data via cookies, Google Analytics (GA4), or Meta Pixel to track site performance.

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To respond to your project inquiries and provide consultation.
  • To deliver the requested Google Ads and Meta Ads services.
  • To analyze website traffic and improve user experience.

3. Data Sharing & Security

  • We never sell, rent, or trade your personal information.
  • Data is only shared with secure third-party tools (like email providers or WhatsApp) required to communicate with you.
  • We use standard security measures to keep your submitted data safe.

4. Cookies

This website uses cookies to improve performance and support our own marketing efforts. You can disable cookies at any time through your browser settings.

5. Contact Me

If you have any questions or concerns about this privacy policy, please contact me:
